phase_name: Phase 19 Completion Evidence Receipt and Consistency Confirmation Design
phase_japanese_name: Phase 19 完了証跡の受領・整合確認
purpose: Design the receipt and consistency confirmation procedure for Phase 19 completion evidence, ensuring all 9 Phase 19 design artifacts are present, internally consistent, and form an unbroken chain before proceeding to the final pre-measurement safety gate

scope_1_phase19_artifact_receipt_checkli.description: Confirm all 9 Phase 19 sub-phase design artifacts exist and are parseable

receipt_checklist.key_content_confirmed: execution_record template with 5 sections and 7 steps
execution_record template with Phase 15-7 dependency and EFFECTIVE/NOT_EFFECTIVE criteria
Structural / mandatory field / type-format / business-logic validation rules
5-step locking procedure, TD_1–TD_5, 4-link chain of custody
5 deficiency categories, 6-step return procedure, 4 HALT scenarios, 13-row decision table
6 inputs, 7 aggregation checks A1–A7, 5-section final report structure
5 preconditions, DG_1–DG_5 rules with precedence, app/tests implementation gate
Phase 19 completion declaration with all 9 sub-phases PASS_DESIGN_ONLY

scope_2_consistency_checks.description: Confirm internal consistency across Phase 19 artifacts

check_C1.description: Phase 19-1/19-2 templates → 19-3 cross-validation → 19-4 format rules → 19-5 locking → 19-6 deficiency handling → 19-7 final verification → 19-8 dual-gate judgment → 19-9 completion declaration form a complete, unbroken design chain
check_C1.pass_condition: Each phase references the prior phase(s) as input; no gaps in the chain
check_C1.fail_outcome: CHAIN_GAP_DETECTED → flag the missing link and route to resolution

check_C2.description: All 9 artifacts declare the same state invariants: integrated_decision=NO_GO, receiver_validator_permission=NOT_EFFECTIVE, app_implementation_status=NO_GO, tests_implementation_status=NO_GO
check_C2.pass_condition: All 9 state_invariant blocks agree on all 4 invariant values
check_C2.fail_outcome: INVARIANT_MISMATCH → identify artifact with inconsistent invariant; flag as design error

check_C3.description: All 9 artifacts include the standard 10-item blocked_actions array
check_C3.pass_condition: All 9 blocked_actions arrays contain all 10 mandated actions

check_C4.description: Confirm Phase 19-8 DUAL_GATE_UNLOCKED is a design template, not an actual unlock
check_C4.pass_condition: Phase 19-8 section_4 implementation_gate_conditions.current_status = LOCKED AND current_status_reason references design phase
check_C4.fail_outcome: DESIGN_INTERPRETATION_ERROR → Phase 19-8 must not be interpreted as actual unlock

check_C5.description: Phase 19-9 completion declaration lists all 9 sub-phases as PASS_DESIGN_ONLY
check_C5.pass_condition: Phase 19-9 sub_phase_checklist has 9 entries, all with status PASS_DESIGN_ONLY
check_C5.fail_outcome: COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE → re-issue Phase 19-9 with full coverage

scope_3_receipt_confirmation_report_stru.description: Design the receipt confirmation report document structure

next_action.if_CONFIRMED: Proceed to Phase 20-2 final safety confirmation
next_action.if_REJECTED: Document failing checks; remediate before proceeding

phase_20_1_completion_criteria: No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
